prompt:
A family sofa on a Sunday afternoon in a 1980s Indian home: a folded newspaper, two cups of tea, cushions, a cooler in the window, the TV off in the corner. Painted like a 1980s Indian family-magazine illustration in flat gouache: warm teak browns, faded teal and cream with one signal orange, soft grain, nostalgic Sunday light. Wide interior composition: the main subject sits in the left third of the frame. Towards the right the same room carries on, quieter and dimmer: a plain painted wall, a doorway, soft shadow. It is one continuous painted room with no panels, no split, no dark band and no second picture. Full-bleed edge to edge, no border, no frame, no people, no faces, no hands. No text, no letters, no numbers, no words, no logos, no badges, no religious symbols, no writing anywhere.
